name: manual.zombie_rider_open_field_mcw
description: Manual playtest handoff: noon open-field zombie-rider pressure with one hostile rider staged at bow range. The harness only loads the save and audits footing; it sends no gameplay keys after load.

steps.label: post_load_manual_rider_open_field_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: manual handoff loads onto the zombie-rider open-field footing before the tester advances time

steps.label: audit_manual_rider_noon
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon time before manual zombie-rider play

steps.label: audit_manual_rider_open_field
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters metadata did not contain the staged zombie rider with expected ammo

manual_playtest.question: Does the zombie rider create scary ranged pressure with readable cover/counterplay, or does it feel unfair or inert?
tester_notes: Try closing distance, breaking line of fire, and retreating.
If safe mode interrupts the feel pass, toggle it yourself and continue.
Save after a short fight or escape if the aftermath looks useful.
metadata_to_check_after: debug.log zombie_rider live_plan and target_probe rows
saved active monster location/hp/ammo after manual play

evidence_contract.claim: manual load starts from current staged zombie-rider footing without harness gameplay input
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: manual handoff footing only; gameplay feel comes from tester play after handoff
